svg.title: Y for YouTube Channel Branding
svg.desc: A 6.5-second looping animation. The original Y and tripod feature a play icon, followed by a fictional branded channel with banner, avatar and thumbnails. The Y moves left, and the YouTube Channel Branding heading and examples of profile icon, channel art and thumbnails appear.
svg.metadata: 1920 by 1080; 16:9; 6.5-second loop. The Y, play icon and tripod knob are traced from 25_Y_youtube_content.png. All visuals, animation and typography are embedded. Channel designs are fictional examples.
